Energy transition:
Equity supports transition to clean energy that
reduces reliance on wood fuel, charcoal, and
fossils fuels like kerosene as a source of energy
and offers the EcoMoto loan, which is available
digitally, to avail financing for clean energy. Over
Shs 15 billion has been disbursed for mitigation
and adaptation in energy and agriculture.

Clean energy
• 100,000 clean energy products financed
• Shs 2 billion finance availed
• 375,683 households reached
• Over 1.5 million people impacted
• Shs 4.5 billion savings for households
• Over 376,122 trees saved through cooking
